steps: Assess threat environment for logistics & supply performance & optimization using intelligence community assessments and wargaming

treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — force readiness level using DRRS-S readiness reporting system. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — force readiness level measured monthly. Target: C1/C2 readiness across force. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against DOD readiness benchmarks. Target: 50% of goal. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — force readiness level trending toward C1 all major units. Escalate if <C3 floor for any unit. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive audit using DOD Global Force Management. Report to Secretary of Defense.
treatments.escalation: If target outcome shows no measurable improvement after 90 days, or if implementation barriers prevent protocol adherence for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a military logistics and sustainment specialist for root cause analysis and intervention redesign. If the intervention produces adverse unintended effects at any point, pause implementation and request specialist review within 14 days.
